generate_notebooks_from_file: generate notebooks from a markdown doc file and save to output directory with framework-specific subfolders
parse_doc_into_cells: parse markdown documentation content into a list of notebook cells including markdown and code cells
split_frameworks: split documentation content into mixed, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX framework-specific sections
clean_content: clean markdown documentation content by removing copyright, open-in-colab markers, and converting math delimiters
expand_links: expand relative markdown links in documentation content to full HuggingFace documentation URLs
